title: Claims Manual Section on Rental Authorizations — Rental Reimbursement Coverage
content:
**Rule.** Under Rental Reimbursement Coverage a rental is authorized only on a physical damage claim with a recorded coverage confirmation. The authorized daily rate never exceeds the package daily limit; the start date is the date the vehicle is left at the repair facility, or the date of loss when the vehicle is not drivable. Rental for a stolen vehicle starts no earlier than 48 hours after the theft was reported. The hours are elapsed hours counted from the report entry; the first eligible rental day is the calendar day on which the waiting hours end. The authorization closes when the vehicle is reported repaired, when 3 days have passed after the settlement offer, when the per-loss maximum is reached, when a stolen vehicle is recovered, or when the customer declines.

## 1. Recorded coverage confirmation

The claim file of the physical damage claim must show a recorded coverage confirmation, and the authorization is issued under that same claim number. What the claim file records decides the matter; the customer's statement that the claim was accepted does not stand in for the recorded confirmation.

## 2. Daily rate ceiling by package

| Package | Authorized daily rate never exceeds |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $20/$600 | USD 20.00 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $25/$750 | USD 25.00 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $30/$900 | USD 30.00 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $40/$1,200 | USD 40.00 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $50/$1,500 | USD 50.00 |
| Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement $60/$1,800 | USD 60.00 |

## 3. The theft waiting clock

- **Clock starts:** the entry on the physical damage claim recording the theft report, on that same claim.
- **Length:** 48 elapsed hours, counted from the report entry.
- **First eligible rental day:** the calendar day on which the 48 hours end; that day itself is eligible.
- **Comparison:** the authorized start for a stolen vehicle is not earlier than that day.

Boundary cases (hypothetical): a theft report entry recorded on day D. The 48 hours end on day D plus two, so day D plus two is the first eligible rental day. An authorized start on day D plus two meets the rule; an authorized start on day D plus one does not.

## 4. When an authorization closes

| Closing event | Authorization closes |
|---|---|
| The vehicle is reported repaired | Yes |
| 3 days have passed after the total loss settlement offer | Yes |
| The per-loss maximum is reached | Yes |
| A stolen vehicle is recovered | Yes |
| The customer declines the rental | Yes |

Hypothetical: the settlement offer is made on day T; once the 3 days after day T have passed, the authorization closes.
